text:
Priya: noticing p99 jump for /v2/generate in eu-west at 21:30, p50/p95 steady. sample_count for that slice dropped ~3x. Might be routing fallback.
Samir: saw same. Traffic shifted to compat-lowmem pool which has downsampling.
Janelle: Is console showing tdigest rollups or raw samples? That matters for p99 correctness.
Priya: Dashboard uses tdigest rollups: SELECT tdigest_percentile(rollup_tdigest,0.99) as p99, sum(sample_count) as samples FROM endpoint_latency_rollups WHERE endpoint='/v2/generate' AND region='eu-west' GROUP BY tb;
Alex: Downsampling + tdigest = brittle tails. We should surface sample provenance and mark p99 low-confidence when samples < 200.
Samir: Agreed. Quick fix: show a small "low confidence" pill and allow an on-demand raw p99 job.
Janelle: I'll mock a provenance pill + tooltip explaining sample_source and sample_count and add a "compute raw" action.
Priya: I'll try a 10% canary disabling telemetry.downsample for compat-lowmem and report back with before/after charts in 15m.
